name: vqa_continual_v1
purpose: Test learning and retention within a shared VQA memory, then attribute retention to the historical loss constraint
stage_selection: Question types from pre-existing metadata; no correctness, output, or answer-based selection. One example per content group globally; balanced types per stage and role. Seeded type interleaving; no stage/subtype retrieval filter. Global seeded bipartite allocation replaces sequential greedy sampling to respect shared-image overlap.
exclude: All previous diagnostic, confirmation and learning memberships plus pilot selection groups; original test untouched. Membership frozen before answer association.
initial_state: fresh empty state in every arm; historical frozen positive checkpoint not reused or retuned

controls.direct: same visible question and image, frozen model and answer scoring; no harness
controls.static: same unchanged harness, memory disabled, no updates
controls.fixed_memory: same raw10/abstract2 feedback storage and frozen-model abstraction as HCL, unconditional batch updates, fixed lexical-overlap top2 retrieval, no prompt search or acceptance gate; fixed policy, not a no-LLM-abstraction control
controls.plasticity: strict current selection gain, format and candidate validity gates; B=infinity
controls.stability: identical to plasticity except B=0 on historical correct-to-wrong anchor count; no offset from recovered cases

model: existing Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct BF16 SDPA, temperature0, max2048 answer512, frozen weights
anchor_contract: Exactly 24 report-disjoint anchors per completed stage accumulated without clustering; stage exists only in evaluator metadata. Retain same-task earlier-stage anchors, exclude current/future stages. Recompute paired reference before each update and save acquired-stage anchor predictions; report total, reference-correct, losses, recoveries and type coverage.
common_runtime: Existing candidate structural contract, fixed historical-memory evidence boundary in all memory arms, identical native VQA scoring; no localization, no tools, no new model/API, no task-name filtering. Disabled prediction/final caches; preprocessing cache may be reused within each arm.
evaluation: Full 4x3 matrix at empty-state and after A/B/C, same 72 groups per stage. Report only, state-read-only. Fixed Direct/Static predictions computed once and reused across cells; explicitly accounted. Never used for checkpoint, candidate, threshold or run selection.
primary_metrics: stage-immediate learning gain relative to preceding checkpoint
final macro exact-match and paired differences versus Static and fixed memory
acquired-stage correct-to-wrong counts on A and B after subsequent learning
worst old-stage loss rate per full 72 and per acquired-correct denominator
training and deployment calls/time/peak memory separately
statistics: 20000 seeded paired content-group bootstrap; paired differences stratified by stage for macro values. Exact paired loss/recovery counts always. Single order and seed, content-group independence not patient independence.

success_rules.learning_and_retention: Stability final macro >= Static+5pp and paired95% lower>0; mean immediate learning gain >=5pp; at least one accepted update in B or C; final acquired-correct losses <=5% of all 72 report groups (at most 3 losses) in EACH of A,B; zero updates cannot support learning.
success_rules.gate_attribution: Only claim demonstrated retention advantage if Plasticity has nonzero old-case losses, Stability has fewer, and paired95% upper for Stability-minus-Plasticity loss<0; mean immediate learning gain no more than5pp below Plasticity. Otherwise attribution inconclusive/unsupported.
success_rules.adaptive_advantage: Only claim benefit beyond fixed memory if final Stability-minus-fixed_memory paired95% lower>0; report all controls regardless. No post-hoc threshold changes.

failure: Independent supervisor with owned-process identity checks and hard timeout; stop sibling arms on fatal failure, keep partial outputs and original clock/call ledger. No automatic restart, result-driven sample change or budget expansion. All invalid/missing outputs remain failures in fixed denominators.
future_scope: This is one bounded method-mainline experiment. Analyze completion under ongoing user authorization; preserve all negatives and do not widen or retune this frozen run.
pre_inference_feasibility_amendment: Initial requested report100/type-balanced stage allocation was infeasible after historical exclusions: five non-presence types require310 distinct validation groups but jointly have253. Before any membership freeze or inference, report quota changed once to72/stage, requiring240 non-presence groups including selection. Stage types, learning/anchor counts, all arms and 5pp effect thresholds unchanged. Preserve failed preparation and original clock.
